mapper.select: select cov.coupon_name, cov.package_unit_price as saleAmount, crd.refund_amount, group_concat(distinct cfp.account_item_name) as refundType, crd.org_id as orgName, crd.crt_id as executorName, cr.reason as remark from coupon_refund_detail crd inner join coupon_refund_pay cfp on cfp.refund_id = crd.refund_id inner join coupon_order_virtual cov on cov.id = crd.order_virtual_id inner join coupon_refund cr on crd.refund_id = cr.id where cov.inservice = 0 and cov.patient_id = #{query.patientId} GROUP BY crd.refund_id

select cov.coupon_name, c.card_number, sc.name as saleChannel, cov.package_unit_price as saleAmount, cb.item_id as itemName, cb.item_type , count(*) as quantity, cb.patient_id as patientName, b.bill_number, cb.crt_time as billDate, cb.org_id as orgName, cb.crt_id as executorName from card_benefit cb inner join card c on cb.card_id = c.id inner join sales_channel sc on sc.id = c.sale_channel_id inner join coupon_order_virtual cov on c.id = cov.card_id inner join coupon_bill b on cov.order_id = b.order_record_id where cb.coupon_type = 5 and cb.patient_id = #{query.patientId} group by cb.card_id,b.bill_number,cb.item_id

select cov.coupon_name, cov.package_unit_price as saleAmount, c.buyer_id as patientName, c.sold_target as ownName, date_format(cc.crt_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as `date`, cc.crt_id as executorName, cc.remark from card c inner join coupon_order_virtual cov on c.id = cov.card_id inner join card_change cc on c.id = cc.card_id and c.sold_target = cc.curr_id where isnull(c.buyer_id) = 0 and c.sold_target != c.buyer_id and c.sold_target = #{query.patientId}
